_comment: Hand-authored inputs to the demand map. Every entry cites the file it was read from.

excluded_by_architecture._source: docs/architecture.md section 5, 'Compatibility categories': Combine-based ObservableObject, StateObject, ObservedObject and onReceive are initially outside inventory (Unsupported API); Observation is the supported model.

block_caveats.swiftui.shapes.fill-stroke: Continuous stroke only; hairline strokes below 1.5 px untested (docs/sr1-status.md 'Known gaps'). Path, trim and dashes are not in this block's symbol list.
block_caveats.swiftui.image: SF Symbols map to Segoe Fluent Icons; 41 symbol sizes use measured ink overrides; glyph shape is reported, not gated (docs/sr1-decisions.md decision 3; docs/sr1-status.md 'Known gaps').
block_caveats.swiftui.stack-overlay: ZStack and overlay only (factory/registry/manifest.json); VStack and HStack have no manifest entry.
block_caveats.swiftui.text.bundled-font: Segoe UI is the Windows body font, so glyph pixels are excluded (decision 2); the bundled Tinos font is exact through ABI 0.7.
block_caveats.swiftui.custom-layout: Layout protocol, left-to-right and right-to-left, exact (docs/sr1-status.md block 5).
block_caveats.swiftui.scroll-view: No ScrollViewReader or scrollPosition in the runtime; vertical offset 0, bottom anchor and horizontal axis measured (docs/sr1-status.md blocks 6).
block_caveats.swiftui.toggle: Switch and checkbox styles, measured at scale 2.5, light and dark (decisions 7, 8, D2).
block_caveats.swiftui.padding-frame: padding all, per edge, EdgeInsets; fixed and flexible frames, 9 alignments (docs/sr1-status.md block 9).
block_caveats.swiftui.preference-key: Custom reduce, nil default, first contribution wins (docs/sr1-status.md block 10).
block_caveats.swiftui.animation: One explicit transaction per flush decides for every changed node; spring cases use a 2 px extent tolerance (docs/sr1-status.md block 18; decisions C1-C6). No Animatable, keyframes or TimelineView in the block's symbol list.
block_caveats.swiftui.opacity-transition: Image fade excluded; no .scale or custom Transition (docs/sr1-status.md block 19).
block_caveats.swiftui.binding: Setter transaction, constant, derived bindings (docs/sr1-status.md block 12).
block_caveats.swiftui.textfield: Windows focus ring not drawn; real IME and TSF deferred to hardware (docs/sr1-status.md block 13).
block_caveats.swiftui.focus-state: UIA keyboard focus is false in the Sandbox; gated through @FocusState text (docs/sr1-status.md block 14).
block_caveats.swiftui.ime-marked-text: Posted WM_IME messages only; real composition needs hardware (docs/sr1-status.md block 15).
block_caveats.swiftui.alert: Windows TaskDialog compared by semantics; main-window pixels reported, never a gate (docs/sr1-status.md block 17).
block_caveats.swiftui.color-scheme: Semantic colours measured light and dark; toggle artwork at scale 2.5 only (docs/sr1-status.md block 20).
block_caveats.swiftui.button: Every style measured in light only; pressed and focused states unmeasured; bordered and prominent are 7-8 px narrower (docs/sr1-status.md block 11).
block_caveats.swiftui.list: No scrolling, no sidebar or grouped styles, no dark appearance, no multi-selection adjacency (docs/sr1-decisions.md A10).

partial_overrides.member-call:fill: Shape.fill is delivered (shapes.fill-stroke); the Canvas GraphicsContext.fill form is not in any block
partial_overrides.member-call:stroke: Shape.stroke is delivered (shapes.fill-stroke); the Canvas GraphicsContext.stroke form is not in any block
partial_overrides.modifier:foregroundStyle: Text colour is gated (docs/sr1-status.md block 8 text-colour gate, decision 11) and Button label colour (decision A3); other receivers are not measured
partial_overrides.env-key:isEnabled: the runtime publishes isEnabled for .disabled (decision 10); reading it through EnvironmentValues is not a manifest symbol

families.name: Vector paths (Path, its builders, StrokeStyle, trim)
families.plan: docs/sr1-plan.md Foundations lists vector paths (fill, stroke, caps, joins, dashes, trim) as a renderer foundation still to add

families.name: Canvas drawing (Canvas, GraphicsContext, shading, layers, filters)
families.plan: not in the SR1 plan; needs a retained-tree escape or a drawing-command ABI

families.name: Transforms and placement (scaleEffect, rotationEffect, offset, position, degrees, radians)
families.plan: docs/sr1-plan.md Foundations: full affine transforms (today translation only)

families.name: Animatable data and spring animation (Animatable, AnimatablePair, spring, snappy, bouncy, delay, keyframes)
families.plan: block 18 covers linear, easeIn/Out/InOut and the default spring (docs/sr1-decisions.md C3-C4); custom springs and Animatable are new

families.name: Pointer, hit testing and gestures (onHover, allowsHitTesting, contentShape, onTapGesture, gestures)
families.plan: docs/sr1-plan.md Foundations lists hit-testing; blocks 11 and 16 gate clicks only

families.name: Backgrounds, clipping and effects (background, clipShape, clipped, mask, shadow, brightness, tint, glassEffect, Glass)
families.plan: docs/sr1-plan.md Foundations: clipping by shape; glass has no Windows source (the Windows notch is solid, pulse/docs/settings.md)

families.name: Type: Font.system, weights, text modifiers
families.plan: block 4 gates Font.custom with bundled Tinos; Font.system is implemented in the runtime (Controls.swift:327) without a case

families.name: Composition helpers (Group, AnyView, EmptyView, Spacer, ViewModifier, GeometryReader, EnvironmentKey, fixedSize)
families.plan: ZStack and overlay are block 3; VStack and HStack are exercised in witnesses only

families.name: Accessibility modifiers
families.plan: docs/architecture.md section 11: every inventory control needs an AccessKit mapping and UIA assertions
